description: Tailor the user's resume for one job: makes a new AI-tailored copy of their resume for that job. Use it for any resume tailoring request, e.g. "tailor / customize / update my resume for this job", "highlight my X work", "add skill Y", "make the summary shorter". Pass applicationId for a saved application, or jobId for a job from search_jobs / match_jobs (it is first added to the user's applications, reusing their existing application for that job). Map the ask to arguments: "highlight / emphasize X" -> modifications; "add skill or keyword Y" -> keywords, plus a modifications line when they want it worked into their experience (e.g. "Add Java to my experience at Tesla"); "shorter summary" or "rewrite my summary" -> sections ["summary"] plus a modifications line saying how. Pass the user's asks through as they phrase them. Every run starts from the user's base resume, never from an earlier tailored copy, so for a follow-up edit on the same job include the earlier asks again with the new one. Set generatePdf: true when the user wants a file to download or send; only then is the copy saved (with a generatedResumeId, filename and download link, and listed by list_generated_resumes). Without it you get the tailored resume JSON only. The base resume is never changed. This does not apply to the job and costs no credits. Takes up to about a minute.

applicationId.description: A saved job application ID (from list_applications or get_application). Pass this or jobId.

generatePdf.description: true when the user wants a file to download or send: saves the tailored copy as a PDF and returns generatedResumeId, filename and downloadUrl. Default false: returns the tailored resume JSON only and saves nothing.

jobHuntId.description: With jobId only: the job hunt to save the job under. Defaults to the most recently updated active job hunt.

jobId.description: A job ID (from search_jobs, match_jobs or get_job) for a job the user has not saved yet; it is added to their applications first. Pass this or applicationId.

keywords.description: Skills or keywords to add or emphasize, as short names, e.g. ["Java", "Spring Boot"].

modifications.description: The user's asks in their own words, one per item, e.g. "Highlight the Kafka and data pipeline work", "Keep the summary to 2 sentences, focused on leadership", "Add Java to my experience at Tesla". Leave it out for a plain "tailor my resume for this job" with no other ask. On a follow-up for the same job, include the earlier asks again.

sections.description: Resume sections to rewrite. Defaults to ["summary", "work", "skills"]. Only the summary: ["summary"].

name: generate_resume_for_job
